enabled.help: The door holding the owner's prompt first. false takes it out.

warnAt.help: The score where the gate starts writing a warn line to the log.

ceiling.help: The score where the gate names the band rewrite in its log line.

words.help: The words an answer holds outside its code and tables.

enabled.help: The tooth. false ends every turn where the agent asks to end it.

mostInARow.help: The turns the tooth carries one after another before it lets go.

hold.help: What the session does when it reaches the end of a turn.

wanted.help: What the owner wants said at the end of this turn.

hook.help: The hook: start the server behind the bridgehead, and click again to kill it. Shift and click starts it under the debugger, paused at the return of decide.

level.help: The level this box writes at. info writes every line a door says, and debug writes what the hooks see too.

open.help: Open the window, on its log tab, in a terminal beside the editor.
keys: w s move up and down the log
enter open the details, and enter again closes them
pgup pgdown step a whole window
home the first line, end the newest, and it follows

functionLines.help: The lines a function holds at most. The write door refuses a write that grows past it.

fileLines.help: The lines a file holds at most. The write door refuses a write that grows past it.

words.help: The words a file, a folder and a branch name each hold at most.

work.comment: Level one. The knobs the work verbs read over a group and its tickets.

staleAfter.help: The age of a held group's tip that puts it under yours.

failsBeforePerson.help: The times a step fails back before the pull inserts a person step.

refusalsBeforePerson.help: The times one hand-back meets refused before the pull inserts a person step.

stepsBeforeSplit.help: The person steps a ticket carries before the pull refuses another and asks for a split.

retroReaders.help: The hands a retro's collect spawns, each taking the next chapter until none stands.

retroCap.help: The tickets a retro's improve step mints, so the list holds what gets done.

engine.comment: Level one. Each key here names a widget nothing draws yet, because an engine has to answer it first. Marking a group is what draws one.

state.help: What a person last asked the engine to do.
state.icon: the owner picks one mark per state: play and stop

vehicle.help: Make a vehicle: a copy of this tree that works on itself, in the folder the press asks for.

stub.help: Make a stub: a bare project this vehicle drives, in the folder the press asks for.

beat.help: The beat the engine touches, which the light beside it reads.

binding.help: Where the session takes its work from. The chapter The engine controls, under spec/design_output/config.md, says what each value means.
